translations.web: But if you have gone astray, being under your husband’s authority, and if you are defiled, and some man has lain with you besides your husband—”
translations.bsb: But if you have gone astray while under your husband’s authority and have defiled yourself and lain carnally with a man other than your husband’—
translations.kjv: But if thou hast gone aside to another instead of thy husband, and if thou be defiled, and some man have lain with thee beside thine husband:
translations.asv: But if thou have gone aside, being under thy husband, and if thou be defiled, and some man have lain with thee besides thy husband:
